posts.title: Looping Casino
posts.description: Autonomous coding loops excel at search, not judgment. They can optimize toward a goal, but they can’t reliably tell when the goal is wrong. Engineering is still more than iteration speed.

posts.title: Known Rot Problem
posts.description: Most leaders can name what's broken. The Known Rot Problem isn't blindness — it's seeing the dysfunction clearly and not moving anyway. Here's why organizations stall even when everyone has the same list.

posts.title: The Speed Tax
posts.description: Speed is seductive, but unchecked velocity creates hidden risk. When building gets cheaper, scrutiny disappears—leading to security gaps, product bloat, and cultures that reward shipping over thinking.
